meta_description:
lakshmisharath on August 13, 2026: "This is my kinda travel. ❤️

Slow journeys. Wandering off the beaten path. Going with the flow. Meeting people, celebrating local cultures, listening to stories and losing myself in ancient temples.

I’ve never really been a bucket-list traveller. I’d rather collect experiences — the unexpected encounters, little detours and stories that stay with you long after the journey is over.

And while I love exploring the world, there’s something about travelling through India that never stops fascinating me. There’s always another story, another place, another experience waiting to be discovered.

50 countries in… but India, always. ❤️

That’s my kinda chic. What’s yours ? 

#KindaChic #MyKindaTravel #SlowTravel #IndiaTravel #storyteller".
